title: Private tour of the Alhambra in Granada, Spain
text: Our tour of the Alhambra was absolutely perfect, thanks to the incredible talent and attention of our guide “JJ”. Not only is he completely fluent in English, he also has knowledge of the Arabic language, and was able to interpret inscriptions for us at the palace. He possesses a command of history to the depth of no other tour guide I have ever encountered.  He was also extremely friendly, helpful and attentive and a lot of fun.  This was the tour of a lifetime!!
author: H7097ASkathrynl

title: Book a Private Guide … Worth Every Penny!
text: We have been to multiple destinations in Madrid, Barcelona, Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Córdoba, Seville and today Granada and have done multiple tours and by far Juanjo (JJ) was our best tour guide. I highly recommend him as your tour guide. The price is a little more than others, but the experience that JJ will give you is priceless! He was an awesome tour guide and passionate about the history of the region and his hometown and made us feel very welcome!
author: Brian_B

title: Our guide JJ was...
text: Our guide JJ was outstanding. He is a local with fabulous knowledge of the Alhambra. He knew how to manage around the crowds and provide us the best experience. He walked at our pace and was so considerate of my wife’s bad knee. He had wonderful stories and knew the history of Alhambra. He is a must if you tour Alhambra.
author: Paul_k

title: Private tour well worth the money
text: Francisco was great and took his time showing us around.  He knew how to navigate the crowds and was very knowledgeable about Alhambra and the history of the region.  He was also a great photographer for some nice group shots of our family!
author: Mitch_M

title: Guide Deserves 10 Stars
text:
Juanjo deserves 10 Stars!! What an absolutely amazing tour guide. Knowledgeable of history, art and religion as they intersect at the Alhambra. Juanjo was engaging, humerous and answered numerous questions patiently. You could not have a better guide or better experience.
We took the early 830am (early October) tour and so glad we did. We were able to escape the crowds and linger at many points. I highly recommend this tour and especially our guide Juanjo.
author: Elga_K

title: Juano was an exceptional...
text: Juano was an exceptional tour guide.  He was knowledgeable and engaged throughout the tour.  He was super friendly and shared an amazing amount of history with our small group.  We had such a great time touring the Alhambra with him.  I would highly recommend this tour!
author: Bernadette_M

title: Outstanding tour and tour guide
text: Such an  Interesting and informative tour. Our tour guide, Juanjo, was exceptional!! He was so energetic, passionate, and knowledgeable! He really made the trip special!!
author: Carol_L

title: A wonderful experience!!
text: Juanjo was a superb guide - friendly, approachable, and excited to share his deep knowledge of the history and personalities of the Alhambra. I highly recommend him!!
author: Venture55190120381

title: Our tour guide Juanjo was...
text: Our tour guide Juanjo was very outgoing in pre-coordinating the tour and adjusting to maximize the Alhambra visit given the earthquakes the day before. His knowledge was deep and varied, so that your particular interests could be focused on. In our case, the historical perspective was most interesting. His love of the monument shone through and as visitors we got to experience some of that passion. I recommend Juanjo as your tour guide during your visit to Granada.
author: Paul_B

title: Amazing!
text: Wow! Beautiful place,  nice gardens, it’s a gem of a place. Our guide was very knowledgeable could read Arabic and was guide us to the most important areas as we had limited time
author: Alnoor_B
